title: Tabcorp Holdings Ltd - proposed acquisition of UNITAB Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced assessment under Merger Review Process Guidelines
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
Proposed annoucement of ACCC findings delayed due to a number of requests for an extension to the deadline to make submissions
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns - Draft 87B undertaking proffered by Tabcorp. ACCC commences market inquiries.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statment of Issues and draft 87B undertakings
ACCC announced that it would oppose the proposed acquisition.
